value.title: media.hash.match
value.description: Match multiple native files against Dandanplay using the MD5 of their first 16 MiB. Returns per-file candidates or explicit errors; an empty candidate list means no hash match. No fallback search, cache, tasks or bindings.

value.title: 在设备上运行程序
value.description: Run a command/script as an ordinary-user background task in this device harness. Disabled by default; only the target host can enable it. No caller environment or credentials are transferred. Windows defaults to cmd (optional powershell), POSIX to sh. task.get/wait expose redacted output tails, exit code and elapsed time; task.cancel stops the process tree. Interrupted commands are not replayed. Completion returns to the originating conversation unless followup:false. Deletion and overwriting require user authorization.

value.description: Live host facts: app.instance identifies the process; app.capabilities reports supported features, provider/source readiness, credential references and required host setup, settings keys, action effects and remote policy. supported means an implementation exists; available means its declared host prerequisites are met, not a successful network probe. No secrets are accepted or returned. Remote writes follow local semantics; disk deletion/overwrite keep their existing NeedsDecision contract. On headless hosts indexing and download destinations treat media roots as read-only; file-channel operations use actual process permissions. A headless host has no Classic history/player/UI. download.import indexes verified files without inferring identity; roots.remove unregisters the root without deleting indexed facts or disk files. settings exposes only returned keys.

actions.title: Identify the connected NipaPlay process
actions.description: Live process and main-window facts for this endpoint. Also returned as instance by nipa status. Paths identify this running build; appBundlePath is null on platforms without application bundles. experimentalProfile identifies the isolated lab configuration, not the Next switch.

value.description: Persistent danmaku sources, caches and tracks. Both GUI and headless use the same NipaPlay Dandanplay gateway/client, host vault reference preferences/dandanplay_token and local import parser. sources reports installed adapters; app.capabilities reports credential readiness. Headless prepares persisted tracks without mounting a player; supply entityId or path because current playback is absent. Metadata identity, acquisition and binding are independent facts. Empty title/hash results mean no source candidate, not a broken host. A successful fetch task proves acquisition; an existing track alone does not. fetch_batch, attach_batch and import_batch accept 1–100 entries matching the single action schema, validate all schemas first, then return input index and complete outcome for every entry. atomic=false; failure retains earlier committed results. Credentials never enter inputs. Task/binding IDs and per-item decisions/errors are preserved. align/align_apply/align_keep are legacyRecovery; new analysis uses analyze_alignment and update. Positive offsetMs advances comments: displayTime=sourceTime-offsetMs. Headless exports are under data/exports.

actions.title: danmaku.align
actions.description: Retired compatibility lookup for existing alignment requestId tasks. New requests return unavailable with migration to danmaku.analyze_alignment and danmaku.update.

actions.title: danmaku.align_apply
actions.description: Legacy recovery only: execute an existing persisted alignment decision option with a task revision check. New analysis returns data and offsets are set through danmaku.update.

actions.title: danmaku.align_keep
actions.description: Legacy recovery only: execute an existing persisted alignment decision option with a task revision check. New analysis returns data and offsets are set through danmaku.update.

actions.title: danmaku.analyze_alignment
actions.description: Estimate a fixed offset from up to 100 supplied source/media time anchors. Returns the upper median, absolute residuals in input order, span, evidence and confidence limits. Reads the binding revision; no task, Decision or persistence. Positive integer milliseconds advance danmaku (display time = source time - offsetMs).

actions.title: danmaku.attach
actions.description: Bind a platform video to entityId, path or the current file (default). Existing platform/video tracks are reused; Classic dandanplay reuse records a binding, with jobId=null. Local pools prevent online acquisition. refresh=true fetches and replaces. Invalid required local ranges fail without mounting; outside-range errors are reported separately. Credentials are opaque host references.

actions.title: danmaku.attach batch
actions.description: Independent entries in input order using danmaku.attach. All schemas are validated before execution. atomic=false; each index returns its complete outcome (including binding/job IDs, decisions or failure). Successful entries are retained when another fails. Each requestId is scoped exactly as in the single action; credentials remain host references.

actions.title: danmaku.cache_delete
actions.description: Delete a specific source cache object and unload bindings using it. Binding evidence remains.

actions.title: danmaku.cache_prune
actions.description: Reclaim oldest recoverable danmaku pools to maxBytes (default 128 MiB). Imported unique copies are excluded. Defers while acquisition tasks are active; unloads evicted pools. Also collects unreferenced content files.

actions.title: danmaku.detach
actions.description: Revoke this managed binding; unreferenced imported content files are deleted, provenance remains. Recoverable source cache remains subject to the cache budget. Classic local, automatic and Dandanplay tracks remain loaded with their managed binding detached. Other managed tracks are removed.

actions.title: danmaku.episodes
actions.description: Read a finite catalogue page. Zero duration means unknown duration. Acquisition requires a finite range within a known media duration.

actions.title: danmaku.export
actions.description: Export one committed binding as JSON to a new file in an authorized media folder. raw preserves original source fields; mapped applies its fixed offset without player filters. Readback is verified.

actions.title: danmaku.fetch
actions.description: Create a cancellable segmented acquisition/cache task for one explicit video/range. Does not modify player tracks. requestId makes retries idempotent. A failed acquisition receipt also reports available Classic cache, assigned/partial Next cache and currently loaded matching player tracks; existing comments do not prove this request succeeded.

actions.title: danmaku.fetch batch
actions.description: Independent entries in input order using danmaku.fetch. All schemas are validated before execution. atomic=false; each index returns its complete outcome (including binding/job IDs, decisions or failure). Successful entries are retained when another fails. Each requestId is scoped exactly as in the single action; credentials remain host references.

actions.title: danmaku.import
actions.description: Import acquired danmaku using Classic local XML/JSON parsing and encoding support, including ARGB colors. Also accepts normalized JSON arrays (or {comments:[...]}): sourceTimeMs (nonnegative integer milliseconds), text, mode (positive integer), colorRgb (nonnegative integer, converted to RGB); optional platformId, sourceEntryId, originSource, sender, sentAt (strings), fontSize (positive integer). No registered source is required. Supply platform/platformVideoId; host records actor, origin and timestamp. Target entityId (file or episode), path, or current playback (default). Reimport replaces the same platform/video pool atomically, preserving track settings; empty or malformed files are rejected and leave the old track unchanged. Mounted immediately when the target is playing. File data stays in host storage; do not send large comment arrays through tool arguments.

actions.title: danmaku.import batch
actions.description: Independent entries in input order using danmaku.import. All schemas are validated before execution. atomic=false; each index returns its complete outcome (including binding/job IDs, decisions or failure). Successful entries are retained when another fails. Each requestId is scoped exactly as in the single action; credentials remain host references.

actions.title: danmaku.offset
actions.description: Compatibility alias for danmaku.update: set an absolute fixed offset in integer milliseconds, positive advances, zero resets. Does not refetch or accumulate offsets.

actions.title: danmaku.resolve
actions.description: Resolve a public URL or platform ID. Multiple parts return executable selection decisions. No persistence.

actions.title: danmaku.search
actions.description: Bounded transient title search. Unsupported sources report unavailable; no binding or task is created.

actions.title: danmaku.set_dedup
actions.description: Compatibility alias for danmaku.update: set absolute deduplicate with a binding revision check. deduplicate controls displayFold only; original source cache is preserved.

actions.title: danmaku.set_enabled
actions.description: Compatibility alias for danmaku.update: set absolute enabled with a binding revision check. deduplicate controls displayFold only; original source cache is preserved.

actions.title: danmaku.sources
actions.description: List registered sources and capabilities. No network or persistence.

actions.title: danmaku.tracks
actions.description: List bindings and all current player tracks, including Classic and local pools with origin/platform/platformVideoId. loaded means mounted in the player registry, including Erika native danmaku; enabled is a track display switch. Neither reports whether comments are currently visible on screen. Accept entityId, path or current (default). Missing file locations are indexed without inferring work identity; no fetch or binding is created.

enabled.description: Track display switch; not proof of visible comments.

loaded.description: Mounted in the player track registry, including Erika native danmaku. Does not prove comments are visible at the current position.

actions.title: danmaku.update
actions.description: Update 1 to 100 bindings or current player tracks in input order. Each item sets enabled, offsetMs and/or displayFold absolutely; positive integer milliseconds advance, negative delay, zero resets. Any explicit offset in the supported range is accepted independently of analysis estimates. Persistent bindings (including bound trackId targets) require expectedRevision; each item is atomic and returns its own result or failure, without rolling back earlier items. Unbound tracks last for the current playback and have no binding revision. displayFold affects display grouping only; original caches remain unchanged.
